correctness.rationale: A full density disintegration yields volume (1−v)(1−u)^(n−1), the normalized beta law V~Beta(n−1,n+2), Z~Beta(1,n), and independent uniform residual variables. Conditional polynomial averaging produces all moments. Five exact beta expectations give the four covariance orbit types, and the two invariant permutation-group blocks diagonalize into the stated four positive rational eigenvalues. Strict matched/unmatched gap is exact subtraction. An independent order-simplex checker agrees for n=2,3,4 on 774 cells; the infinite-dimensional assertion rests on the analytic proof, not finite tests. Endpoint n=2 and the asymptotic limit are addressed.

value.rationale: The standard-example poset is the canonical extremal family for poset order dimension. Its 2n-dimensional order polytope has a nontrivial connected constraint graph and no previous evaluated Euclidean covariance geometry found in the inspected sources. The two-beta law provides exact, easy sampling and all polynomial moments in all dimensions; the four rational spectral branches determine the affine-invariant isotropic constant and its cube-limit, and a strict matched/unmatched correlation gap records the deleted matching in the covariance. This is a motivated complete invariant classification, not a rederivation of the already-known volume or a numerical slice.
